library.name: PPG Review Evidence
library.note: Use separate libraries/permissions for differing access needs; never put source and drafts into one unrestricted clinical publication surface.

extraSyncRecords: Add only when QW3 needs persistent checkpoint/alias handling.
fullSourcePreservation: All 25 fields and raw values remain in the snapshot/envelope even if initial views expose fewer.
sourceDateDisplay: Next review month is qualified YYYY-MM; raw serial retained separately.
fieldOwnershipBoundary: Logical importer/local ownership in separate Lists; inherited site access retained; not a claim of SharePoint column-level security.
caseRolePresentation: Content-review role; proposed content custody, acceptance/capacity and executive accountability are separate.
identityContractHandling: Original ledger is immutable bootstrap; accepted amendments and active ledger are committed with the successful importer checkpoint. New identities require separately evidenced operator-supplied UUIDs; sourceIdentityDecisionRef is creation-only importer provenance.
